name: Community digest
description: Every Monday, gathers the past week of sero-labs/sero activity — merged PRs, issues, discussions, releases — plus any Discord highlights you pasted into the community inbox, and drafts an honest weekly community update you can publish as a Discord post and GitHub Discussion. Drafts only: it never posts anywhere.
limitations: GitHub-only sources: Sero has no Discord-reading integration, so Discord highlights come from a manual paste-in file (docs/marketing/community-inbox.md) — keep it updated or the digest covers GitHub only. Quiet weeks produce a short 'quiet week' draft, not filler. Nothing is ever posted; publishing is a manual step.
